## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] The commit messages follow `<type>(<scope>): <subject>`.
- [ ] If the change alters what a user sees or does (an install step, a command,
      a default, a prerequisite or a version), `README.md` and the page of
      `docs/` that covers it are updated in this pull request.
- [ ] If the change alters an action's input or output, `make schemas` was run
      and the snapshots are committed.
- [ ] A change to an architecture decision comes as a new ADR in `docs/adr/`.
